name: Sattus
title: Levite who returned from exile
summary: Sattus (also known as Shabbetai) was a Levite mentioned in connection with Ezra's reforms after the return from the Babylonian exile. He was among those who helped the people understand the Law and participated in the work of addressing mixed marriages among the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: Reading and Explanation of the Law
keyEvents.description: Sattus was among the Levites who helped the people understand God's Law when Ezra read it aloud to the assembly.

keyEvents.title: Participation in Ezra's Reforms
keyEvents.description: Sattus was involved in handling the issue of mixed marriages among those who had returned from exile.

keyEvents.title: Oversight of Temple Work
keyEvents.description: As a Levite, Sattus participated in overseeing work related to the temple and its services after the rebuilding.

keyEvents.title: The People's Renewal of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Sattus was among the Levites who stood forward when the people renewed their covenant with God under Nehemiah's leadership.
